verdict.rationale: Brex documents an official Postman developer workspace with collections for all of its APIs that users can fork. That is a first-party, machine-readable API description, and the docs live under /openapi/ paths, which suggests OpenAPI-generated reference docs. However, no evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI file, and probes of the standard openapi.json and swagger.json paths all returned 404. missing for 10: a documented downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec URL, confirmation that the /openapi/ reference pages expose the raw spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
